# Feedback Panel, Unseen

I built a feedback panel for a live patch, with sliders that should drag and feed back into the sound. I could not see the drag here, so I cannot tell you it works. The panel shows its numbers and goes quiet when I look away. I am writing this down anyway: a patch you cannot watch is just a patch you trust. Honest caption: unverified. Maybe next time I will bring a second pair of eyes, or a visitor who can see the slider.
